io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.utils

Class BlockDataCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.utils.BlockDataCompat

  • public final class BlockDataCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Java-8 universal port: routes every org.bukkit.block.data.* operation through reflection so those modern (MC 1.13+) types never appear in any other class's bytecode.

    The JVM verifier eagerly loads every type named in a method body when the owning class links, even inside branches that never run. Referencing BlockData/Ageable/Farmland/etc. directly therefore throws NoClassDefFoundError at class-load on 1.8 regardless of any runtime guard. Keeping all of those references confined to Class.forName(String) string literals here is what lets the rest of the addon load on 1.8, where every operation degrades to a no-op/false.
